notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 2 – Development Update & Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We’ve been quiet for a while, but during this time we’ve made significant progress on our game. With this update, we want to share the details of our new title, Car Dealership Simulator 2, and celebrate our excitement with you.


Big news: We’re launching on September 26th!


We’ve expanded the map by adding new regions and made the gameplay smoother and more enjoyable. 

Each vehicle has been carefully crafted; we’ve enhanced their visual details with precision and improved their driving dynamics to deliver a more realistic and satisfying experience.



Even after release, we’ll continue updating the game with new cars, refined mechanics, and community-driven content shaped by your feedback. 



With every update, our goal is to make the experience even more fun and fulfilling, while growing the game together by listening to our players’ requests and suggestions.



Join us on this journey by supporting the development of our game—share your thoughts, comments, and feedback so we can take it even further together!


Our new gameplay trailer is live!

[previewyoutube="vp8RJt316pI;full"][/previewyoutube]


Don’t forget to like and comment on our trailer! Share your thoughts with us.

notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 0.4 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Car Dealership Simulator 0.4 Update


Important!!

 Question: Is my save file broken in this update?
 Answer: Yes.
 Question: Will my save file continue to get broken as the game receives updates?
 Answer: Yes, your save files will be broken as new content is added to the game. Because the newly added features do not match your save files. Thank you for your understanding!!


[Fixes]
- There was a save error in a vehicle, fixed.
- There were bugs in car gallery upgrades, fixed.

[Content]
- Added 11 new vehicles.
- Added online vehicle purchase.
- Added change player vehicle.
- Part paint control system has been added to vehicles purchased from the internet.
- Added 2 new car gallery upgrades.
- Car parks has been increased to 15.
- Tax added to vehicles.
- Added luxury vehicle buy place.
- Car wash model has been changed.
